name: Haiku small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Growth-oriented portfolio targeting fast-growing cloud, AI, and fintech companies in the small-to-mid-cap range. Focus on businesses benefiting from secular trends: cloud migration, AI/ML adoption, cybersecurity spending, and digital transformation. Equal-weighted allocation emphasizes individual growth potential while maintaining sector diversification.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: These 10 mid-cap technology and fintech companies combine strong growth fundamentals with exposure to expanding secular trends. The portfolio emphasizes businesses with high revenue growth, expanding margins, and products addressing enterprise modernization needs. Equal-weighting ensures conviction in each position while maintaining diversification across cloud platforms, cybersecurity, data infrastructure, and software development tools.
